[[File:Mission_terminal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Various mission terminals]]
A '''mission terminal''' was a device by which individuals could learn about short-term offers of employment. Such terminals generally listed the employer, the job available, and the amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] offered for successful completion of the task outlined. Mission terminals were subject to [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], which allowed individuals with the right skills to increase the payout offered. Typical opportunities offered on such devices might include delivery of a cargo, destruction of some target, apprehension of a wanted subject, creation of goods for sale, bookings for performances, or reconnaissance.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], such terminals were located on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and in many major [[City/Legends|cities]]. Both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made use of mission terminals to deliver missions to their agents in the field.
